mentions.name: Learning Spanish
mentions.description: This personal language-learning practice reads Spanish books before bed, hand-copies paragraphs from the book into a journal, highlights unknown words to look up later, and reads a book while listening to its audiobook at the same time.
mentions.source_excerpt:
LEARNING SPANISH 
- What's working for me... trying to read spanish books before bed. Handwriting a few paragraphs from a book into journal. Highlighting words I don't know. Looking them up later. Reading a book while listening to its audio book at the same time.
